pages.title: Tier 0: Foundational
pages.text: $(li)Dirt Bee: Produces Dirt.$(br)$(li)Stone Bee: Produces Cobblestone.$(br)$(li)Sand Bee: Produces Sand.$(br)$(li)Gravel Bee: Produces Flint.$(br)$(li)Water Bee: Produces Prismarine Shards.

pages.title: Tier 1: Simple Hybrids
pages.text: $(li)Mossy Bee: Produces Moss Blocks.$(br)$(li)Lumber Bee: A worker bee that produces Tree Sap.$(br)$(li)Honey Bee: Produces Honey Blocks.

pages.title: Tier 2: First Resources
pages.text: $(li)Coal Bee: Produces Coal.$(br)$(li)Resin Bee: Produces Sweet Honey fuel.

pages.title: Tier 3: Metals
pages.text: $(li)Copper Bee: Produces Raw Copper.$(br)$(li)Iron Bee: Produces Raw Iron.$(br)$(li)Gold Bee: Produces Raw Gold.

pages.title: Tier 4: Gems & Magic
pages.text: $(li)Lapis Bee: Produces Lapis Lazuli.$(br)$(li)Redstone Bee: Produces Redstone Dust.$(br)$(li)Slime Bee: A rare find, produces Slime Balls.
